title: Which Everyday Style Fits You Best?
intro: Six questions about what you reach for most. Your result names the style your answers lean toward, with ideas to build on it.

questions.text: Which shoes do you wear most often?
Pick a jacket for a cool evening.

options.text: Whatever stands out in the room

questions.text: What matters most when you shop?
How would friends describe your look?

results.title: Classic
results.description: Your answers lean toward tailored pieces in steady colors. Build on a navy blazer, straight trousers, and leather shoes that work with most of what you own.

results.title: Minimal
results.description: Your answers lean toward a small wardrobe where everything matches. Keep to two or three neutrals and clean shapes, and replace pieces instead of adding them.

results.title: Relaxed
results.description: Your answers lean toward comfort and soft fabrics. Denim, knits and canvas suit you, with one sharper piece for the days that need it.

results.title: Bold
results.description: Your answers lean toward color and pieces people remember. Pair one statement item with plain basics so it stands out instead of competing.
